No JS errors on page. issues: Two recharts ResponsiveContainer warnings on mount: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — cosmetic, panel still renders. Likely a parent flexbox without explicit width on first paint. Not blocking.

Pre-login the page emits a few 401 'Failed to load resource' console errors from background calls (e.g., /api/auth/me probe). Cosmetic — expected for an unauthenticated visitor — but worth gating these probes behind a 'has-token' check to keep DevTools clean.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4826 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. The new v1.7.5 admob/client-stats endpoints (lines 2922-3088) and daily-calibration claim (lines 1753-1830) would naturally extract into routers/monetization.py + routers/calibration.py. Splitting before v1.8.0 will avoid the file becoming unmergeable.

POST /api/admin/admob/config currently uses `payload: dict = ...` — no Pydantic model. Switching to a typed AdmobConfigOverrideIn(BaseModel) with explicit fields (admob_app_id: Optional[str], admob_test_mode: Optional[bool], admob_enabled: Optional[bool], ...) would give 422-on-bad-input + OpenAPI docs for free, and prevent typos in keys silently being ignored.

Status code choice for the Light ad-gate (HTTP 402 'Payment Required' with detail='ad_not_completed') is defensible but unconventional; 403 'Forbidden' with code='ad_required' is more idiomatic. As requested, no change made — flagging only.

_admob_runtime_config() is pure-env right now. POST /api/admin/admob/config writes to db.admob_config but the read paths (_admob_runtime_config / GET /admob/config / GET /admin/admob/config) never load that document — admin writes are effectively a no-op until you wire in `await db.admob_config.find_one({'id':'global'})` as a final override step. The endpoint docstring 'Operator override stored in MongoDB' is currently misleading.

get_current_user (server.py:179-201) reads access_token from cookie FIRST and falls back to Bearer header. Pytest sessions sharing requests.Session can mix admin-cookie + worker-Bearer; we worked around with per-test fresh requests.Session. If you ever want to enforce 'Bearer wins over stale cookie' set get_current_user to check Authorization header first, then cookie — would also help iOS/Android Webview clients that set both.

/api/daily-calibration/claim returns the same JSON shape for 'fresh claim' and 'already_claimed_today'. Currently status='already_claimed_today' carries reward_tgc copied from the prior row, which is fine, but the v1.7.5 ad-gate metadata (client_type, ad_completed, ad_mode of the ORIGINAL claim) is NOT echoed in that response. Tests have to GET /daily-calibration/status to see them. Consider echoing them in the claim response for the Light APK so it can reconcile its local 'I watched an ad today' state.

/api/admin/client-stats `tgc_issued_by_client` aggregates positive tgc_ledger rows by client_type, but historical ledger rows pre-v1.7.5 have no client_type field → all bucketed under 'unknown', skewing the Light vs Node Pro split downward for the first few weeks of telemetry. Worth a one-off backfill script (or document that 'unknown' is the historical baseline).

context_for_next_testing_agent: v1.7.5 surfaces validated end-to-end. ENV-driven AdMob config: backend/.env has ADMOB_ENABLED=true, ADMOB_TEST_MODE=true, real IDs empty → test-mode IDs returned to clients. The Light ad-gate is enforced ONLY when payload.client_type=='light' (literal string match); any other value (node_pro, unknown, omitted, misspelled) bypasses the gate by design — confirmed via tests test_nodepro_no_ad_gate / test_empty_body_backward_compat / test_unknown_client_type_no_ad_gate. The POST /api/admin/admob/config DB override is currently NOT consulted by the read paths (see critical_code_review_comments) — flag for E1 if operator-driven runtime override is a required feature; otherwise the .env-only path is fine. Pytest shared-Session cookie leak is a known gotcha: get_current_user prefers cookies; use a fresh requests.Session per role (the new test file does this via _client()).
rca_of_the_issue: No production bugs found. One test-side trap encountered + resolved: shared requests.Session causes admin httponly cookies to leak into worker-Bearer requests because backend's get_current_user prefers cookie over Authorization header. Fixed by giving admin / worker / anon paths their own requests.Session instances via _client(). Captured in critical_code_review_comments for future test agents and as a server.py hardening suggestion.
